Package neqsim.thermo.phase

Class CubicPureSaturation

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.phase.CubicPureSaturation
public final class CubicPureSaturation extends Object
Pressure bracket for distinct pure-fluid roots of the ordinary SRK and PR equations.

1.0
Author:
NeqSim contributors

  • Method Details

    • pressure

      public static double pressure(PhaseEos phase)
      Evaluates the pressure separating two mechanically stable roots with equal fugacity.
      Parameters:
      phase - initialized ordinary cubic pure phase
      Returns:
      saturation pressure in bara
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the phase is not an ordinary pure SRK or PR phase
      IllegalStateException - if distinct subcritical roots cannot be bracketed

    • requiredAttraction

      private static double requiredAttraction(double y, double e, double f)
      Returns the attraction needed for zero pressure slope at reduced density y=b/v.
      Parameters:
      y - reduced density
      e - sum of cubic shape constants
      f - product of cubic shape constants
      Returns:
      dimensionless attraction

    • spinodal

      private static double spinodal(double low, double high, double strength, double e, double f)
      Bisects one spinodal on either side of the critical reduced density.
      Parameters:

      high - upper density
      strength - dimensionless attraction
      e - sum of cubic shape constants
      f - product of cubic shape constants
      Returns:
      spinodal reduced density

    • density

      private static double density(double low, double high, double target, double strength, double e, double f)
      Bisects a stable density branch; unlike Cardano roots this retains dilute liquid-root precision.
      Parameters:
      low - lower density
      high - upper density
      target - pressure scaled by RT/b
      strength - attraction scaled by RTb
      e - sum of cubic shape constants
      f - product of cubic shape constants
      Returns:
      density on the selected stable branch

    • residual

      private static double residual(PhaseEos phase, double strength, double b, double rt, double pressure, double yGas, double yLiquid)
      Compares fugacities on the two stable density branches without mutating a phase.
      Parameters:
      phase - ordinary cubic phase supplying shape constants
      strength - attraction scaled by RTb
      b - molar covolume
      rt - gas constant times temperature
      pressure - trial pressure
      yGas - gas spinodal density
      yLiquid - liquid spinodal density
      Returns:
      log vapor fugacity minus log liquid fugacity
